introduction: Explore Tikitzopl’s city, river, forest and households. The leader’s native exchange sacrifices a scared-kitty item for a temple key. Follow separate leads about living animal protection, voluntary freedom, city services and the deeper temple.
orientation: Learn a current route into Tikitzopl and back. The city, river, forest and deeper temple have different paths and travel constraints.
Meet the Sacrificial Leader near the pit. His exact scared-kitty exchange grants a temple key and sacrifices the animal described by the item.
Decide whether to complete that native exchange. It records the sacrifice for a key;it does not record animal rescue or a humane care outcome.
If choosing the exchange, carry one exact scared-kitty item loose in your inventory. A recovered or supplied copy fits without your own source encounter.
The mage’s dwelling and pet shop are associated with the kitty item. Source recovery, a supplied copy and a settled purchase are different histories.
Animal protection at the cages needs a builder-defined living recipient and useful care outcome. The journal has no agreed humane alternative to the sacrifice yet.
The mothers, children and servants suggest stories about safety and voluntary freedom. Ordinary following, combat or removal does not itself record helping them.
Meet the faeries and learn about the ancient forest and meadow. The journal has no agreed tree or living animal-care task from their profile alone.
Use the right key for the snake pit, storerooms, bench, house or temple approach. Finding a key, unlocking and making an admitted passage are separate steps.
Prepare for the river and bridges under their actual movement rules. A journey needs a safe admitted landing and return, not only reaching a bridge.
City shops have separate original services. Listing is different from a useful settled purchase or repair;purchases and repairs are currently unavailable.
Food, potions, wands, staff and the eyepiece have distinct real effects. Possession or a use attempt does not itself record successful useful help.
The upstairs inn room offers refuge under its original rules. Meeting the innkeeper and completing an admitted successful save are different milestones.
The library, council, jail and theater suggest knowledge, civic and restoration stories. The journal has no agreed completion from scenery or profiles alone.
Some city equipment belongs to the deeper temple’s competing commissions. The temple key, those independent exchanges and its return route remain separate stories.

stories.title: The leader’s sacrifice for a temple key
stories.summary: Choose whether to bring the exact scared-kitty item to the leader. His accepted exchange sacrifices the animal described by the item and grants a temple key. A recovered or supplied copy fits. Rescue and temple passage are separate outcomes.

steps.text: Prepare the kitty item for the sacrifice
steps.hint: If choosing this exchange, carry one exact copy loose. A supplied copy fits. The leader will sacrifice it for a temple key;this does not record animal rescue.

steps.text: Record the accepted sacrifice for the key
steps.hint: The accepted native sacrifice remains recorded after the kitty item is spent. Receiving a key, opening the approach and entering the deeper temple are separate milestones.
